text: Implemented row-major flattening aligned to voxel-major labels, dimensional consistency checks, and runwise term-name recovery in R/fmri_lm_methods.R. Added exact cell-by-cell tests against coef(), standard_error(), stats(), and p_values() for 2 terms x 3 voxels. Corrected a_09_linear_model.Rmd claims and examples for AR(1), robust SEs, significance, fitted HRFs, and AIC selection. Evidence: focused/adjacent suites pass; fresh corrected vignette render succeeded with all hidden assertions.
